Rule / Conclusion: Nghị định 06/2022 as amended by Nghị định 119/2025 and Nghị định 83/2026 is the core regulatory framework.

Rule / Conclusion: Annual GHG emissions ≥ 3,000 tCO2e is an inventory criterion.

Rule / Conclusion: Thermal power / industrial production with annual energy consumption ≥ 1,000 TOE is an inventory criterion.
Freight transport company with annual fuel use ≥ 1,000 TOE is an inventory criterion.
Commercial building with annual energy use ≥ 1,000 TOE is an inventory criterion.
Solid waste facility with annual operating capacity ≥ 65,000 tonnes is an inventory criterion.
Decision 13/2024/QĐ-TTg remains the effective inventory list until 24/09/2026.
Caution: Do not continue using it after Decision 42 becomes effective.
Facilities removed from the new list receive the transition treatment stated in Article 3.

Rule / Conclusion: 2025-2026 allocation covers thermal power, iron & steel and cement facilities within the inventory-list scope.
Caution: Being subject to inventory is not the same as having an allocated quota.

Rule / Conclusion: 2025 total = 243,082,392 tCO2e; 2026 total = 268,391,454 tCO2e for 34 thermal, 25 steel and 51 cement facilities.
Caution: Totals are validation targets, not inputs to force facility calculations.

Rule / Conclusion: Decision 699/QĐ-BNNMT allocates 2025 and 2026 allowances to 110 facilities and requires surrender under Article 19.
Caution: Use official allocation for compliance; calculated A is a model reproduction / validation output.

Rule / Conclusion: A = P_avg × B × T; historical window is y-1, y-2, y-3; B = ΣE_avg / ΣP_avg; T = (1+g)(1-r).
Legal Basis: Appendix I to amended Nghị định 06
Caution: g and r values must not be guessed; leave unverified values blank.

Rule / Conclusion: Surrender must be at least direct-source inventory emissions for the allocation phase minus carbon credits used for offset.
Caution: Historical E_avg for allocation and direct emissions for compliance are different concepts.

Rule / Conclusion: Surrender is due before 31 December of the year following the allocation phase.
Caution: Deadline shown in workbook is derived from the phase end year.

Rule / Conclusion: Credits may offset no more than 30% of allocated allowances.
Caution: Input above the cap is flagged.

Rule / Conclusion: Through end-2030, borrowing from the next phase may not exceed 15% of allowances allocated for the current phase.
Caution: Borrowed allowances are not available for exchange.
